label: baseline
description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-09-04 against workflows@460aba43. Delivery is 35,800 characters above the previous recording of 1,392,659 at workflows@875a36dc, a 2.6% rise, and the corpus jump spans three merges: the workflows-branch canon audit, the contract blind spots that gave the convergence loop its declared writes, and the loop-continuation migration that moved every repeat-until test off `condition` and onto `continueWhile`. The third dominates, and it buys steps that had never run. A doWhile loop runs its body and then decides whether to run it again; while the continuation test lived on `condition`, both mechanical readers took it as an entry gate and read an unbound variable as false, so six of the eight top-level doWhile loops entered nothing at all. Their bodies now walk. The walk reaches nine more techniques than it did — six more bundled and three more fetched, 66 to 72 and 24 to 27 — and eight more delivered content keys, 265 to 273. get_activity rises 29,313 of the total, which is those bodies arriving in the activities that own them: the simplification apply cycle, the review-fix cycle, the validate fix-and-revalidate cycle and the await-review loop. get_technique rises 6,040 for the operations those bodies bind. get_workflow rises 225 and get_resource 222, both from the canon audit and the contract work rather than from the loops. The resource ledger is unchanged at 75 keys: no body reads a resource the walk had not already fetched.
